rows.Benefits Description.Reconstructive surg: Not covered: • Cosmetic surgery - any surgical procedure (or any portion of procedure) performed primarily to improve physical through change in bodily form, except repair of accidental injury (See Section 5(d), Accidental injury) • Surgeries related to sexual dysfunction • Surgeries to correct congenital anomalies for individuals age and older unless there is a functional deficit • Charges for photographs to document physical conditions • Surgery for Sex-Trait Modification to treat gender dysphoria. If you are mid-treatment under this Plan, within a surgical or chemical regimen for Sex-Trait Modification for diagnosed dysphoria, for services for which you received coverage under 2025 Plan brochure, you may seek an exception to continue care for that treatment. Our exception process is as follows: To the exception process, contact Customer Care at 800-821-6136, Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. - 8 p.m. E.T. If you disagree with our decision on your exception, please see Section 8 of this brochure for the disputed claims process.
